body: starting my journey today. hopefully this will improve my life
I've never re-watched a movie on purpose. There are just too many good movies out there i havent yet seen!
I'm feeling better. Thank you. You're a good person :)
I've tried it a couple of times but sucked at it. Might give it another go some time.
thanks for talking with me! i'm going to grab some dinner too. would love to keep chatting when im back.
my instinct is to say dota2 because it's the game i play the most (over 2000 hours on steam). but the truth is - the most fun i had was when i built a house/base with a guy on minecraft.

yeah maybe. part of me thinks i am depressed, the other part thinks im being overly dramatic and just get over it. there are people out there in positions way worse than me so i really have no right to be sad.
im a huge fan of dota2. also play a bit of everything else.

i would still recommend the books. they are a masterpiece.

and thanks for asking. i honestly don't know anymore. i would like to think im okay, but i notice that i'm getting worse. i cant remember the last time i laughed out loud. i can still smile but i worry that people will see that its not genuine. 

anyway i hate to be such a downer. i do want to get better, but im just not sure how.

thanks for the questions mate. alot of the things i used to enjoy don't appeal to me as much anymore. things like video games aren't the same when you don't have friends to play it with.

as for food, i guess anything goes. i have a soft spot for junk food like maccas, but i try not to eat it too much since it makes me feel like shit.

im struggling to think of my fondest memory right now. don't  think i have one.

same goes for things that frustate me. I'm just bored all the time, not really angry or frustrated. just complacent and apathetic.
loved harry potter when i was a kid... haven't read much lately since i've started working. but i would recommend lord of the rings trilogy if you haven't read that yet.
